decisionBoundary.statement: Human review required to assess fit for the Group Product Manager, Developer Platform role.

evidence.text: Group Product Manager for the developer platform of a SaaS company since 2022, managing the platform's three product managers; product manager and senior product manager on the same company's API products from 2016 to 2022; nine years of product management in all, three years of them managing product managers.
evidence.notes: Directly states years of experience and management of product managers.

evidence.text: Owner of the pricing and packaging of the platform's API tiers with the commercial team, with the two tier changes of 2023 and 2024 approved on pricing proposals under my name.
evidence.notes: Explicit ownership of pricing and packaging with commercial team.

evidence.text: Set the platform roadmap with the product director each half-year and ran the quarterly roadmap review with engineering leadership, with the review decks and decision logs in the product folder.
evidence.notes: Directly addresses roadmap setting and quarterly review.

evidence.text: Coached the three product managers under the product group's coaching practice, with the coaching notes and the growth plans filed with the product director.
